header.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.PICore_OP
header.description: SIMATIC IT Process Industries Operational Core
header.author: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateWorkOrderByWorkOrder
command.description: Creates a new Work Order as copy of an an existing Work Order. The command may return the following error codes, during its execution: * Error -10938: The Work Order already exists. * Error -10937: The Work Order with the specified NId was not found. * Error -10963: The CreateWorkOrderByWorkOrder command failed creating the Work Order. * Error -10950: The Work Order update failed. * Error -10956: There is no Operation that references the Operation with the specified NId and Revision. * Error -10995: It was not possible to associate the Equipment Requirement with the Operation. * Error -10978: It was not possible to associate Material with the Operation Material Requirement.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteProcessParameterToWorkOrderHeader
command.description: Deletes a process parameter from the Work Order Header.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteProcessParameterToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Deletes a process parameter from a Work Order Operation.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateProcessParameterToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Updates the value of a Parameter Requirement of a Work Order Operation. If the Parameter Requirement is linked to a Task Parameter, and the Task has not been activated yet, the Task Parameter value is updated with the given argument ParameterValue. If the value of an input parameter is empty or null, the respective property of the Parameter Requirement is not changed. Checks if: - the given Id of the Parameter Requirement of the Work Order Operation exists, otherwise it throws the error 10945; - the given ParameterValue, ParameterToleranceLow, ParameterToleranceHigh, ParameterLimitLow, ParameterLimitHigh, ParameterActualValue values are of the same type than its ParameterType value, otherwise it throws the error 10835; Checks if the Parameter Requirement of the Work Order Operation has a TaskNId and a TaskParameterNId neither null nor empty; If so, if the given Task is in an initial status, the command calls the command UpdateTaskParameter which will update the value of the Task Parameter property of the respective Parameter Requirement with the ParameterValue passed by the original command: - if the UpdateTaskParameter command fails, it throws an error code that this command will return (to know more about the possible errors, check the ref. doc. of the UpdateTaskParameter); - if, for some reason, it is impossible to call the UpdateTaskParameter command, the error 10960 is thrown.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateProcessParameterToWorkOrderHeader
command.description: Updates the value of a process parameter of a Work Order Header.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteMaterialRequirementMTU
command.description: Removes the association previously set between a list of MTUs and a Work Order Operation Material Requirement.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.WorkOrderOperationChangedStatusToIsInProgress
command.description: Changes the status of the Work Order Operation into "IsInProgress".

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.WorkOrderOperationChangedStatusToIsCompleted
command.description: Updates the ActualEndTime field of the Work Order Operation. Additionally it verifies if all the Work Order Operations of the Work Order are in final state. If they are, it completes the Work Order. Otherwise it starts the following Work Order Operations by increasing sequence if two conditions are filled: the operations must have IsInExecutionPropagation set to True and there is no planned start date.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.WorkOrderChangedStatusToIsInProgress
command.description: Changes the status of a Work Order into "IsInProgress".

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.WorkOrderChangedStatusToIsCompleted
command.description: Changes the status of a Work Order into "IsCompleted".

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateWorkOrderExtended
command.description: Creates a Work Order and its Work Order Extended. The Planned Start Time property is specific of the Work Order Extended. This command is used by the UI and does not create WO operations.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderOperationExtended
command.description: Resets and/or Updates one or more properties of a Work Order Operation and its extension. The command resets a property when it has been set to empty and updates its value, if specified. The command may return the following error codes, during its execution: * -10948: The Work Order Operation does not exist. * -10996: The Work Master Operation has not been found. * -11314: The Estimated Duration cannot be negative. * -10996: The piece of Equipment set as Actual Equipment has not been found. * -11311: Planned Start Time cannot be equal to or later than the Planned End Time. * -10979: Actual Start Time cannot be equal to or later than the Actual End Time. * -10981: The Update of the Work Order Operation failed. * -10982: The creation of the Task for the specified Work Order has failed.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderOperationMaterialRequirementExtended
command.description: Updates one or more properties of a Work Order Operation Material Requirement.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirementsToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Associates to the specified Work Order Operation the given list of Equipment Requirements. Reminder: an Equipment Requirement could be a piece of Equipment, or an Equipment Group, or both. Checks if the Work Order Operation exists. Throws the error 10948 otherwise. Checks if the Work Order Operation is Frozen. Throws the error 10992 otherwise. Then for each Equipment Requirement of the given list, the command performs the following checks: 1. Checks if the Sequence of the Equipment Requirement is positive, if not error 10997 is returned. 2. Checks if the Planned Equipment of the Equipment Requirement exists, if not error 10996 is returned. 3. Checks that either a piece of Equipment or an Equipment Group is specified, if not error 10309 is returned. 4. If both an Equipment Group and the piece of Equipment are specified, checks if the piece of Equipment belongs to this group, if not error 10993 is reutrned. 5. Checks if the speicfied PlannedSetupStartTime is inferior to the specified PlannedSetupEndTime, if not error 11315 otherwise. 6. If the "IsMain" property is set to True, checks if the Equipment Group identifier is specified, if not error -10899 is returned.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteWorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirement
command.description: Deletes a Work Order Operation Equipment Requirement.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirement
command.description: Updates a Work Order Operation Equipment Requirement. Assigns the value of Sequence, RequirementTag and PlannedEquipmentNId Properties from the given command inputs: if an empty value is given, it deletes an existing value. This is not applied for the value of the arguments EquipmentGroupNId and EquipmentNId: an empty value does not delete an existing value. Optionally flags the Equipment Requirement setting is as Main. This applies only to Equipment Requirement that specifies the EquipmentGroupNId. Any other Equipment Requirement previously set as Main will have the flag reset. Warning: if you define both the EquipmentNId and EquipmentGroupNId arguments: the command verifies if the piece of Equipment defined by the EquipmentNId is part of Equipment Group defined by the EquipmentGroupNId. If it is not the case, it throws the error 10861. Checks if the given Equipment Requirement Id exists. Throws the error 10300 otherwise. Checks if the PlannedEquipmentNId, EquipmentNId, or EquipmentGroupNId exist. Throws the error 10996 otherwise. Checks if the value of the PlannedSetupStartTime is inferior to the value of the PlannedSetupEndTime. Throws the error 11315 otherwise. If the "IsMain" property is set equal to True, checks if the Equipment Group identifier is specified, If not error -10899 is returned;

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetWorkOrderOperationActualEquipment
command.description: Sets the Work Order Operation that must be executed on the actual Equipment.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UnsetWorkOrderOperationActualEquipment
command.description: Removes the association between the Work Order Operation and the actual Equipment.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationMaterialRequirementsToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Associates, to the specified Work Order Operation, the list of Material Requirements that will be used during the operation execution.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationActualMaterialsToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Checks if the Work Order Operation is already associated with an Actual Material with the same NId, Revision and Sequence of the Material that is going to be added as Material actually in use.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteWorkOrderOperationActualMaterial
command.description: Removes the association between the Work Order Operation and the Actual Material, given as input.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderOperationActualMaterial
command.description: Updates one or more properties of a Work Order Operation Actual Material.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteActualMaterialMTU
command.description: Removes the association previously set between a list of MTUs and the Actual Material of a Work Order Operation.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateWorkOrderByWorkMasterV2
command.description: Creates a new Work Order specifying which Work Master should be used as basis for Operations, Parameters and Specifications. The command may return the following error codes, during its execution: * Error -10300: The Order does not exist. * Error -10100: Generic Error. * Error -10952: The WorkOrderExtended entity has not been found for Work Order with the specified Id. * Error -10996: The Current revision of Operation has not been found. * Error -10957: There is no Operation that references the Operation with the specified NId. * Error -10956: There is no Operation that references the Operation with the specified NId and Revision. * Error -10983: The Work Order with the specified NId could not be created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddProcessParametersToWorkOrderHeader
command.description: Adds a list of process parameters, taken from the catalog, to a Work Order Header. It is possible to override each parameter target value.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderExtendedV2
command.description: Resets and/or Updates one or more editable properties of a Work Order and its Work Order Extended. The command resets a property when it has been modified to empty and updates a property when it has been modified to a new value. The command may return the following error codes, during its execution: * -10934: The Work Order has not been found. * -10992: The Work Order is frozen. * -11311: Planned Start Time cannot be equal to or later than the Planned End Time. * -10979: Actual Start Time cannot be equal to or later than the Actual End Time. * -10807: The Material does not exist. * -10855: No Material is set as current. * -10002: Not compatible unit of measures. * -10957: There is no Operation referencing a current Operation. * -10956: There is no Operation that references the specified Operation. * -10984: The State Machine is not valid, because it has no initial Status. * -10981: The specified Work Order Operation could not be updated.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddParameterRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationFromCatalog
command.description: Adds a list of Parameter Requirements to a Work Order Operation, from a list of Catalog parameters. This command creates Parameter Requirements where the values of the limits and tolerances are initiated as they are provided to the command, even if they are expessed in percents. If you wish to assign the real values of these limits and tolerances in the Parameter Requirements to be created, you must call another command; AddParameterRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationFromCatalog. Checks if : - the Work Order Operation Id exists, otherwise it throws the error 10948; - the Work Order Operation isn't frozen, otherwise it throws the error 10992; For each element of the given ProcessParameters list, the command controls: - if the selected Catalog Parameter exists in the Catalog and if the Catalog Parameter doesn't exists already for the given Work Order Operation, otherwise it throws the error 10999; - if the ParameterValue, ParameterToleranceLow, ParameterToleranceHigh, ParameterLimitLow, ParameterLimitHigh values of the given Catalog Parameter are of the same type than its ParameterType value, otherwise it throws the error 10835; - the given Catalog Parameter ProcessDefinitionNId exists (if defined), otherwise it throws the error 11210; - the given Catalog Parameter UoMNId exists (if defined), otherwise it throws the error 10803. - if a given Catalog Parameter ProcessDefinitionRevision isn't null or empty, checks if it exists and belongs to the associated ProcessDefinitionNId, otherwise it throws the error 10895. If any of the controls on the list elements fails, the command will not add any Parameter Requirement at all.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddParameterRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationFromProcessDefinition
command.description: Adds a list of Parameter Requirements to a Work Order Operation, taking them from a Process Definition.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.CompleteWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Completes the Work Order Operation if the following constraints are met: - All the Tasks linked to the Work Order Operation are in a final status. - All the Work Processes linked to the Work Order Operation are in a final status.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.CreateWorkOrders
command.description: Creates a set of Work Orders according to the parameters given as input. If a Priority is defined, all Work Orders to be created will inherit this Priority. The following informations will not be propagated from the source Order: Planned Start/End Time, Material, Equipment, Properties.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.CalculateScalingRatio
command.description: Calculates a linear ratio between the Reference Quantity and the Work Order Quantity. Context is filled only when this command is called by CreateWorkOrderByWorkMasterV2 and can be used by the system integrator to perform custom logic.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddRequirementsToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Adds a set of requirements to a Work Order Operation.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationToWorkOrderWithRequirements
command.description: Adds a Work Order Operation with all its Requirements to a Work Order. About the Work Order, the command checks: 1. if it exists, if not error 10300 is returned; 2. if it is not Frozen, if not error 10992 is returned. Then, the command updates the Work Order by adding the new Work Order Operation. If it fails, an error is returned by the involved subcommand: UpdateWorkOrderExtendedV2. Then the command adds the Requirements to the added Work Order Operation. If it fails, an error is returned by the involved subcommand AddRequirementsToWorkOrderOperation.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddMTUsToWorkOrderOperationMaterialRequirementV2
command.description: Associates a list of MTUs and/or Material Lots and/or Material Tracking Unit Aggregates to a Work Order Operation Material Requirement. The Command checks: If the Work Order Operation has any Material Requirement, if not Error -10940 is returned. If there is at least one MTU to add , if not the Command returns an empty list as an answer.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateMaterialRequirementMTUV2
command.description: Updates one or more properties of the association between a Material Requirement MTU and a Work Order Operation Material Requirement.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddMTUsToWorkOrderOperationActualMaterialV2
command.description: Associates a list of MTUs and/or Material Lots and/or Material Tracking Unit Aggregates to a Work Order Operation Actual Material. The Command checks: If the Work Order Operation has any Actual Material, if not Error -10940 is returned. If there is at least one MTU to add , if not the Command returns an empty list as an answer.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateActualMaterialMTUV2
command.description: Updates one or more properties of the association between an Actual Material MTU and a Work Order Operation Actual Material.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationsToWorkOrderFromOrder
command.description: Adds one or more Work Order Operations to a Work Order from Order

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationMaterialRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationsFromOrder
command.description: Associates, to the specified Order Work Orders, the list of Material Requirements that will be used during the execution.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.RecordWorkOrderOperationActualMaterial
command.description: Records the assignment of the Actual Material to a Work Order Operation.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationsFromOrder
command.description: Associates the Equipment Requirements to Work Order Operations of a Work Order respectively to the Equipment Requirements of Order Operations of a given Order. For each Work Order Operation, gets the matching Order Operation and updates the Work Order Operation if there are Equipment Requirements.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationParameterRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationsFromOrder
command.description: Associates the Parameter Requirements to Work Order Operations of a Work Order respectively to the Parameter Requirements of Order Operations of a given Order. Verifies that the Order exists, that the Work Order exists and is not frozen, that the Work Order Parameter Requirements do not already exist for the related Work Order Operation, or errors will be raised.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.GetWorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirementsFromTags
command.description: Returns, from a Task, the list Ids of its Work Order Operation Equipment Requirements which have a Requirement Tag matching any value of list of Requirement Tag values passed as argument.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.GetWorkOrderOperationMaterialRequirementsFromTags
command.description: Returns, from a Task, the list Ids of its Work Order Operation Material Requirements which have a Requirement Tag matching any value of list of Requirement Tag values passed as argument.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.StartNewWorkProcessFromEntity
command.description: Creates and starts a work process for an entity. Checks that the process definition exists for the given revision, that the revision is set as current, and that the process definition is set as executable. Errors raised: 11200 if not executable, 10889 if revision is undefined and there is no current revision, 10895 if no process definition exists with the given revision.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.StartNewWorkProcessExtended
command.description: Creates and runs a new Work Process. Checks that the Process Definition exists for the given revision, that the revision is set as current, and that the process definition is set as executable. If the parameter NId is not specified, a value is generated automatically by using the Numbering Pattern for Work Process. If the parameter Name is not specified, the Process Definition name is used as value. If the parameter Description is not specified, the Process Definition description is used as value. The command may return the following error codes: * Error -11200: The Process Definition is not executable. * Error -10889: The Process Definition revision is undefined and there is no current revision * Error -10895: The Process Definition does not exists with the given revision. * Error -10818: The Work Process NId cannot be generated using the Numbering Pattern.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.StartPlannedWorkOrderOperations
command.description: Start Work Order operations for which the status is equal to "Ready" and the planned start time stored in PlannedStartTime property has been reached.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetTaskEquipmentFromWorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirements
command.description: Sets the piece of equipment of the Task from its Work Order Operation Equipment Requirements. It requires that the Task Property Assign\_From\_Equipment\_Requirements is set to true. The command takes in account the Required\_Equipment\_Tag property of the Task.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.ActivatePITask
command.description: Activates a Task according to the configuration.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationByWorkMasterOperation
command.description: Adds a Work Order Operation, together with its Requirements, to a Work Order, given the data of a Work Master Operation, which has been made available for Work Order enrichment. Checks if the Work Order exists, otherwise it throws the error 10300. Checks if the Work Order is frozen, otherwise it throws the error 10992. Checks if the Work Master exists, otherwise it throws the error 10300. Checks if the State Machine (of the given Work Master Operation) exists, and that this State Machine has an initial status, otherwise it throws the error 10984.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationActualEquipmentToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Creates a new Actual Equipment of a Work Order Operation. The to-be-created WoOp Actual Equipment have properties that are initiated with the values of the Equipment Requirement that it is related to. The commands verifies that: - the given WorkOrderOperationEquipmentRequirementId exists, otherwise it throws the error 11225; - the given Actual Equipment NId exists, otherwise it throws the error code 10859; - the related Work Order Operation isn't frozen, otherwise it throws the error code 10992. The command creates a new WoOp Actual Equipment with the given equipment and the data of the given Equipment Requirement. If an Actual Equipment already exists with the same data, no Actual Equipment is added and the command throws the error 11224. An Actual Equipment already exists when its property ActualEquipmentNId equals the given argument and its properties match the fields of the given Equipment Requirement. The command returns an identifier of the Work Order Operation Actual Equipment that was created.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationActualEquipmentToWorkOrderOperationFromTask
command.description: Retrieves the EquipmentNId as saved in the EquipmentNId property of the given Task. Checks that the Task exists, otherwise throws the Error 11309. If the Task has its property Assign\_From_Equipment\_Requirement set to true, the command searches for eventual related Equipment Requirements of the Work Order Operation related to the Task. Only if the property Assign\_From\_Equipment\_Requirement is set to true, it calls the command AddWorkOrderOperationActualEquipmentToWorkOrderOperation that will create the Actual Equipment. If the result of the AddWorkOrderOperationActualEquipmentToWorkOrderOperation command returns an error code (that isn't equal to error code 11224), it throws the error 11226.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddRequirementsByWorkMasterOperationToWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Adds a set of Requirements to a Work Order Operation from the Specifications of the given Work Master Operation. For each command arguments IncludeOperationEquipmentSpecifications, IncludeOperationMaterialSpecifications, and IncludeOperationParameterSpecifications, if equal to true, the command respectively retrieves the Equipment Specifications, the Material Specifications, and/or the Parameter Specifications of the given Work Master Operation. The commands checks the given Work Order Operation, testing: 1. if it exists, if not error 10300 is raised; 2. if it is Frozen, if not error 10992 is raised. Then it checks if the Work Master Operation exists: if not error 10300 is raised. If IncludeOperationParameterSpecifications is true, the command calls the command CalculateScalingRatio. If no error thrown, it calls the subcommand AddRequirementsToWorkOrderOperation to create all Work Order Operation Requirements.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DeleteWorkOrderOperationActualEquipment
command.description: Deletes an Actual Equipment (of a Work Order Operation). This command checks if the given Actual Equipment exists. Otherwise it throws the error 11313.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationActualMaterialsByMaterialRequirements
command.description: Associates, to the specified Work Order Operation, the list of Actual Materials that will be used during its execution, based on the Material Requirements already associated to the same Work Order Operation. About the Work Order Operation, the command checks: 1. if it exists, if not error 10300 is returned; 2. if it is not Frozen, if not error 10992 is returned. If there are any Material Requirements, it checks if there are already Actual Materials related to the given Work Order Operation : 1. if there are none, it calls the subcommand AddWorkOrderOperationActualMaterialWithMTUs; 2. if there are some, it calls the subcommand AddMTUsToWorkOrderOperationActualMaterialV2. If it fails, an error is returned by the involved subcommand.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddWorkOrderOperationActualMaterialWithMTUs
command.description: Associates a list of MTUs and/or Material Lots to a newly created Work Order Operation Actual Material.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AddParameterRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationFromCatalogCalculatingPercentages
command.description: Adds a list of Parameter Requirements to a Work Order Operation, from a list of Catalog parameters. If you wish to assign the real values of these limits and tolerances in the Parameter Requirements to be created, you must call another command; AddParameterRequirementsToWorkOrderOperationFromCatalog. This command takes in account if the limits and tolerances are expressed in percents. If so, the values of the limits and tolerances are calculated. They are of the same type than the Parameter Requirement. Their value is calculated based on their percentage value of the Target Value. Checks if : - the Work Order Operation Id exists, otherwise it throws the error 10948; - the Work Order Operation isn't frozen, otherwise it throws the error 10992; For each element of the given ProcessParameters list, the command controls: - if the selected Catalog Parameter exists in the Catalog and if the Catalog Parameter doesn't exists already for the given Work Order Operation, otherwise it throws the error 10999; - if the ParameterValue, ParameterToleranceLow, ParameterToleranceHigh, ParameterLimitLow, ParameterLimitHigh values of the given Catalog Parameter are of the same type than its ParameterType value, otherwise it throws the error 10835; - the given Catalog Parameter ProcessDefinitionNId exists (if defined), otherwise it throws the error 11210; - the given Catalog Parameter UoMNId exists (if defined), otherwise it throws the error 10803. - if a given Catalog Parameter ProcessDefinitionRevision isn't null or empty, checks if it exists and belongs to the associated ProcessDefinitionNId, otherwise it throws the error 10895. If any of the controls on the list elements fails, the command will not add any Parameter Requirement at all.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.WriteApplicationLog
command.description: Logs messages in the Opcenter EX FN Application Log. INTERNAL USE ONLY.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.ManageTaskOutcomingStatus
command.description: Calls the Command AddWorkOrderOperationActualEquipmentToWorkOrderOperationFromTask if the Task Status becomes Aborted, Canceled, Completed, Failed, or Skipped.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.SetWorkOrderOperationActualEquipmentFromTask
command.description: Updates the Actual Equipment of Work Order Operation based on a related Task, setting the Actual Equipment value equal to the Task Equipment value. By default, this only happens when the Task Status switches to InProgress. The command performs the following checks: 1. if the given Task exists, if not error -11309 is returned; 2. if the given Task is specified with a piece of Equipment, if not error -11326 is returned; 3. if the given Task is related to a Work Order Operation, if not error -11326 is returned; 4. if the Work Order Operation related to the Task exists, if not error -11312 is returned; 5. if the call to the sub Command UpdateWorkOrderOperationExtended is successful, if not error -10981 is returned.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderOperationParameterRequirement
command.description: Updates the Equipment for a Parameter Requirement of a Work Order Operation. The command returns the respective error code by performing the following checks: 10968: checks if the Equipment being associated with Parameter Requirement is a valid Equipment. 10969: checks if parameters already exist with same Equipment association or without any association before saving the Equipment modifications.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.MigrateWorkOrderOperationWorkProcess
command.description: Migrates all associations between Work Order Operation and Work Process. It marks all associations for an automatic execution already defined at enginneering time.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.AssociateManualProcessDefinitionsWithWorkOrderOperation
command.description: Associates a Work Order Operation to one or more Process Definitions. The command may return the following error codes: * -10300: The Work Order Operation specified in input does not exist. * -10890: Two revisions of a Process Definition cannot be associated to the Work Order Operation. * -10889: One of the Process Definitions you are associating has no revision set to current. * -10811: A Process Definition with specified NId and Revision does not exist. * -10892: A Process Definition could not be found. * -11349: The Process Definition with NId: {0} and Revision: {1} is not associated to the PIProcessDefinitionContext.

command.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.DisassociateManualProcessDefinitionsFromWorkOrderOperation

The command may return the following error codes, if some checks on input parameters fail: * Error -10300: The Work Order Operation with the specified NId does not exist. * Error -10843: There is no Process Definition with NId and revision linked to the Operation. * Error -11347: The Process Definition with specified NId and Revision is not for Manual Execution. * Error -11348: The Process Definition with specified NId and Revision has been already executed.

commandAction.name: Siemens.SimaticIT.UAPI.OperationalData.PICore_OP.OPModel.Commands.UpdateWorkOrderActualQuantityHandlerShell
commandAction.description: Updates the Work Order Actual Quantity with the total quantity of produced MTU's in the Work Order that matching the MaterialId/Revision of the Work Order. This post action is executed after the command AddMTUsToWorkOrderOperationActualMaterials. When MTUs are added to an OUTPUT Material Actual on a work order operation that matches the MaterialId/Revision defined at the Work Order header. The quantity is converted into the UoM defined in the Actual Qty UoM of the Work Order header. The post action will: 1. Retrieve the WorkOrderOperationActualMaterial 2. check if the WorkOrderOperationActualMaterial exists 3. retrieve the WorkOrder 4. check if the WorkOrder exists 5. check if there is a match between WorkOrder material NId/Revision and WorkOrderOperationActualMaterial NId/Revision 6. retrieve the WorkOrderExtended facet 7. calculate the new WorkOrderActualQuantity as sum between the current WorkOrderActualQuantity with of all the MTUs added to the WorkOrderOperationActualMaterial performing also a UoM conversion to the WorkOrder UoM. 8. check if the new WorkOrderActualQuantity is different from the previous one or null 9. update the WorkOrderActualQuantity (QuantityValue and UoM). The post action performs the following checks: 1. if WorkOrderOperationActualMaterial exists, if not post action exit without updating the WorkOrderActualQuantity. 2. if WorkOrder exists, if not post action exit without updating the WorkOrderActualQuantity. 3. if there is a match between WorkOrder material NId/Revision and WorkOrderOperationActualMaterial NId/Revision, if not post action exit without updating the WorkOrderActualQuantity. 4. if the UoM conversion has been executed with success, if not a not blocking error is traced and the quantity converted is set to null. 5. if the new WorkOrderActualQuantity is different from the previous one or null, if not warning and the post action exit without updating the WorkOrderActualQuantity 5. if the CallCommand fails, the same error returned by command is traced.
